year-over-year-by-category.reason: Previous vs current year side by side for each revenue category, the current-year bar coloured by the sign of the change (up, down, unchanged). ChartKit 0.7.0's ColumnChart now prints category labels whole (the eight-character cut is gone), but a series still has one colour: ColumnPoint has no tone, so the direction of each change would be lost. BarChart rows take a tone but draw one series, so they cannot pair two years. Migrate when ColumnChart takes a per-point tone.
